summary: VEON filed a 6-K furnishing its 3Q26 press release, earnings release, presentation and factbook, disclosing 1.55 million ADSs repurchased for USD 112.5 million under an aggregate 2.9 million ADS buyback program, with 1.08 million ADSs (1.5% of issued shares) cancelled effective October 20, 2026 and all repurchased shares to be cancelled. The release also reported 3Q26 revenue up 17.2% YoY to USD 1,307 million, EBITDA up 10.1% to USD 577 million, and raised mid-point 2026 revenue and EBITDA guidance. A Capital Markets Day is set for November 16. Watch buyback execution pace and any incremental return of capital signals.
